title: Joy: a fox that looks like Joy
kaylee: Aunt Joy at Agong's house is a proper fox now, with Joy's long hair, big smile and lace blouse. New since your last notes: her puffy cheeks are back, flatter than the old ones, in two versions for you to choose.
questions: Choose one: A (white cheeks) or B (pink cheeks)?
Inside her ears is a paler orange so they still read as ears. Good, or plain orange all through?
